title: DFlash verifier implementation plan: oracle target-verifier cost first

hard_gate_math.interpretation: If oracle target verification for W=8 costs more than about 1.72x one-token decode, DFlash cannot reach 10 tok/s even under the optimistic positional upper bound and zero draft overhead. Under a more realistic prefix estimate, the threshold is about 1.13x.

existing_vendor_evidence.interpretation: The existing coarse fixed-text diagnostic did not show measurable target batch speedup. It is not a precise oracle verifier measurement, but it blocks full DFlash runtime work until a stricter verifier-cost probe passes.

source_findings.finding: Existing target speculative path adds drafted tokens to batch_tgt and verifies with one llama_decode(ctx_tgt, batch_tgt). This pattern can be reused by an oracle verifier cost probe.
common_sampler_sample_and_accept_n() already implements greedy accept/reject from target logits for a draft sequence.
DeepSeek4 maintains per-layer high-capacity state inpL_hc. DFlash aux taps likely require post-layer inpL_hc for layers [3,13,23,32,42].
Public embedding APIs expose final output embeddings, not arbitrary layer hidden-state taps.
cb_eval can copy named tensors for diagnostics, but D2H copies are too expensive for final hot path.
EAGLE3 hidden-state speculation state is still TODO; no ready hidden-state draft runtime exists.

next_allowed_implementation.name: oracle_target_verifier_cost_probe
next_allowed_implementation.runtime_scope: diagnostic-only, default-off, no DFlash weights, no SOTA promotion
inputs: fixed France text used by the top1 verifier
oracle future tokens from that fixed text
required_outputs: C_verify(W) in units of one accepted single-token decode
top1 agreement for each oracle window
strict_gates: source and artifact committed/pushed if the diagnostic is added
next_allowed_implementation.reopen_full_dflash_loader_only_if: C_verify(W) is below the optimistic threshold with at least 500ms aggregate overhead slack and top1 is exact. Otherwise DFlash is closed for the 10 tok/s objective under current vendor target verification.

blocked_items: Persistent disk is still insufficient for the 3.6GB DFlash artifact on /dev/root.
No full DFlash loader/converter should be written until the oracle verifier cost gate passes.
Hidden-state tap mapping is unproven; cb_eval can be used for shape diagnostics only after verifier cost is promising.

decision.next_action: Implement or script the oracle target-verifier cost probe, then run it under the strict 16GB cgroup before any DFlash loader work.
